public_rationale: GitHub's June 1, 2026 announcement states that Copilot plans now bill based on AI Credits consumed [e1]. Its June 1 FAQ allows existing annual subscribers to keep request-based billing until their subscriptions expire [e2]. These implementation records do not establish what the reported internal plan said on April 22, 2026 [e1] [e2].
limitations: The packet contains no authenticated April 22 planning documents or independent verification of their contents.
The annual-plan exception does not establish whether the original plan included those customers.
A rollout beginning in June does not require every customer to migrate that month.
